title: Meet Eva Outram, UK woman who quit her $58,000 NHS job; now lives in a caravan and saves $3,200 a month
summary_full: After her impactful experience on 'Alone', Eva Outram, formerly an NHS project manager, swapped her city life for a caravan with her partner, Tom Park, focusing on simplicity and financial freedom. By working on farms for accommodation, they manage to save about $3,200 every month. Outram envisions creating outdoor skill workshops to foster nature appreciation and has plans to eventually buy land to construct their own residence.
